# What the merge of `improve-skill` and the vendored `writing-great-skills` into
# `skill-review` had to carry over, one line per idea, as `label :: regex`.
#
# Two skills became one, and the sections were rewritten rather than moved, so
# there are no headings to match the way `standard-split.sh` matches them. What
# survives a rewrite is the vocabulary: each idea is pinned by the word the
# merged skill has to still be teaching. A line that goes missing here is a
# lens a reviewer stops applying, and nothing else in the suite would notice.

predictability is the root virtue :: [Pp]redictab
the description decides triggering :: description
invocation is a choice with a cost :: disable-model-invocation
altitude: principle where it varies, step where it must not :: altitude
over-specification that drifts :: (hardcoded|brittle|over-specif)
the information hierarchy and what sits where :: [Ii]nformation hierarchy
a pointer decides whether the material is reached :: pointer
completion criteria are checkable :: [Cc]ompletion criteri
premature completion :: [Pp]remature completion
leading words :: [Ll]eading word
a no-op is a line the model already obeys :: no-op
duplication and the single source of truth :: (duplicat|single source of truth)
sprawl and sediment :: ([Ss]prawl|[Ss]ediment)
negation backfires; prompt the positive :: (negation|prohibition)
match the form to the failure :: (form to the failure|recipe|structural slot)
when a skill should be split :: split
contradictions and ambiguous referents :: (contradict|referent)
failure, stopping, and handing off to a sibling skill :: sibling
the output a downstream consumer reads :: output
evidence of how the skill actually ran :: (transcript|run)
a behavioural claim is tested against a no-guidance control :: control
